recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I decides on a new IG publication configuration resource in a future tracker; FHIR-13982 itself is satisfied by the current ImplementationGuide model.
issue_request: FHIR-13982 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request from STU3, applied for R5, asking whether the growing ig.json control file should become a formal resource such as ImplementationGuideControl. Jira comments narrowed the direction toward moving portable input/output information into the existing ImplementationGuide resource rather than creating an IG-publisher-specific new resource, and the recorded resolution says this had already been agreed in principle.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found for FHIR-13982. The implicit application is the 2018 ImplementationGuide rework commit b319b6a0dac9ca63360026abf48be963f7b143b9, which removed ImplementationGuideInput and ImplementationGuideOutput from the active resource list and added formal ImplementationGuide.definition and ImplementationGuide.manifest structures for publisher build input and assembled output information.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps ImplementationGuide active in the build and lists ImplementationGuideInput/ImplementationGuideOutput only under removed resources. The current ImplementationGuide StructureDefinition contains definition, parameter, template, and manifest elements describing source file/resource locations, build parameters, templates, and assembled output. Later FHIR-I minutes and FHIR-24649 refined this model by adding page source[x]; FHIR-24649 is already represented on the combined branch and does not require another commit here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build already carries the formal resource representation requested by the issue, inside the existing ImplementationGuide resource, and there is no remaining current-spec semantic gap that would justify introducing a new resource or duplicating tooling-specific ig.json prose.

related_jiras.note: Added ImplementationGuide.definition.page.source[x] after the same ig.json-going-away discussion; already represented on the combined branch.
